public.heroTitle: Own gold, one gram at a time
public.heroBody: Buy and sell vaulted gold and platinum in Ethiopian birr — live market prices, receipts for every trade, and a vault that is never oversold.
public.trust1Body: ALKEVA does not sell a gram it does not hold. Every purchase is checked against the vault before it settles.
public.trust2Body: Every settled trade carries a serial-numbered receipt with the exact price, fees, and the price source it was taken from.
public.trust3Body: You confirm against a quoted price that is held for you for 30 seconds — never against a moving number.
public.legalDraftNotice: Draft — this text describes how the platform actually works and will be replaced by counsel-approved terms before public launch.
public.legalTerms1: ALKEVA is a digital platform for buying and selling vaulted precious metals in Ethiopian birr. ALKEVA acts as the counterparty to every trade: you buy from and sell to the platform at quoted prices that expire after 30 seconds.
public.legalTerms2: Every balance change is recorded as a pair of immutable ledger entries. Deposits and withdrawals move through licensed payment providers. Identity verification is required before depositing, withdrawing, or trading.
public.legalTerms3: Trading limits apply per account tier. The platform may pause buying when vault reserves would be exceeded and may hold transactions for compliance review. Frozen accounts retain their holdings; freezing suspends actions, never balances.
public.legalPrivacy1: ALKEVA collects the information needed to operate a regulated financial service: your name, email, identity documents you submit for verification, and the transaction records the service inherently produces.
public.legalPrivacy2: Identity documents are stored encrypted and are reviewed only by authorised compliance staff. Every staff action on your account is written to an append-only audit log.
public.legalPrivacy3: Your data is not sold. It is shared only with the payment provider processing your deposits and withdrawals, and with authorities where the law requires it.
public.marketTitle: The market, as the platform sees it
public.marketBody: Prices come from an international metals feed converted to birr and refresh continuously. The number on this page is the same tick the trading screen quotes.
public.marketSource: Source and exact time are stamped on every quote and every receipt.
public.stepsTitle: From birr to metal in three steps
public.step1Body: Deposit birr with Telebirr, CBEBirr, a bank transfer, or a card. The balance is credited only after the payment is verified with the provider.
public.step2Title: Buy at a price held for you
public.step2Body: The price, the commission and the total are all on screen before you confirm. The quote is locked for 30 seconds — you never confirm against a moving number.
public.step3Body: Your grams sit in the vault. Sell back at the live price whenever you want, or request physical delivery once your holding reaches the top bands.
public.rulesBody: Not policies we promise to follow. Gates written into the code that runs every trade — the same code the audit log records.
public.rule1Title: Never a gram the vault does not hold
public.rule1Body: Every purchase is checked against the reserve inside the transaction that settles it. If the vault would be oversold, the buy is refused. There is no override, for anyone.
public.rule2Body: A balance is the sum of immutable ledger entries. Nothing in the admin console can add or remove a cent — every movement is a pair of entries that must sum to zero.
public.rule3Body: You confirm against a quote, not a live price. When it runs out you are given a new one, so a trade is never silently re-priced under you.
public.rule4Body: Payouts above the review threshold need a second approver, and nobody may approve their own. Every staff action lands in an append-only audit log.
public.rule5Body: The Amharic assistant explains prices, fees and your own position. It cannot trade, approve, freeze, or move anything — it has no write access at all.
public.receiptTitle: Every settled trade leaves a document
public.receiptBody: A serial number allocated at settlement, the exact unit price, every fee line, and the feed and moment the price was taken from. It opens, it shares, it prints.
public.tiersBody: As the value you hold grows, your account moves through gemstone bands. Higher bands raise the per-transaction and daily limits, and the top bands unlock physical delivery of your metal.
public.tiersNote: Levels are computed from what you hold — nothing to apply for.
public.ethiopia1Body: Deposits and withdrawals run through Chapa: Telebirr, CBEBirr, bank transfer, and card.
public.ethiopia2Body: The whole product, including the assistant, works in Amharic. English is one tap away.
public.ethiopia3Body: Receipts and daily limits use East Africa Time, so a document never changes its hour with the reader's laptop.
public.ethiopia4Body: Verification is required before money moves, reviewed by compliance staff, and stored encrypted.
public.faq1A: The vault holds physical metal, and the platform refuses any purchase that would issue more grams than it holds. Coverage — vault grams against issued grams — is shown inside the app on every screen where you buy.
public.faq2A: A commission on each trade, shown as its own line on the quote and on the receipt before you confirm. There is no subscription and no custody fee.
public.faq3A: Yes, at the live price, in the same screen you buy from. The birr lands in your balance immediately and can be withdrawn to your bank.
public.faq4A: Smaller amounts are sent to your bank as soon as you request them. Larger amounts wait for a finance approver — the birr sits in a hold, visibly out of your balance, until it settles or is returned.
public.faq5Q: What if the price feed goes down?
public.faq5A: The app keeps showing the last known price with its timestamp, and the platform refuses to quote on a stale tick rather than guess.
public.faq6Q: Can I get the metal itself?
public.faq6A: Physical delivery can be requested from the top holding bands. Our team reviews the request and confirms the handover with you directly.
